fact: The National Digital Development Strategy of December 2022 lists as a long-term action, for 2027, "Extend broadband access to all government institutions nationwide, including local councils, schools, hospitals, libraries", led by the Ministry of Information and Communications with DSTI, the Universal Access Development Fund, NDiDA, NaTCA, Leonecom, Zoodlabs and internet service providers as partners, and names local councils among the public buildings whose connection is to be prioritised; no cost is set against the action.
title: Sierra Leone National Digital Development Strategy
publisher: Ministry of Information and Communications, Government of Sierra Leone
